fusions.name: Mile-End Blow
fusions.desc: A full-weight blow that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Cobble Setter
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground flat ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hobnailed Boots
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 15% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Beaten Road
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 5%.
